academics.title: Academic setup
academics.description: Your school's years, classes, subjects and who teaches what.

years.name: Name

classes.students: {count, plural, =0 {No students} one {# student} other {# students}}

assignments.emptyDescription: Choose which teacher takes each subject in each class section.

imports.title: Import & export
imports.description: Bring your school's lists into EduCore from a spreadsheet, or download them.

kindDescriptions.STUDENTS: One row per student, with their class and (optionally) one parent or guardian. Re-importing the same admission number updates the student.
kindDescriptions.STAFF: Teachers, admins and accountants. The role column says which (teacher, admin or accountant). Matched on email.
kindDescriptions.CLASSES: One row per class and section for the chosen year, e.g. JSS 1 / A. Import these before students.

imports.fileHint: Save your spreadsheet as CSV (UTF-8). Max 2 MB / 5,000 rows. Dates as DD/MM/YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD.
imports.exportDescription: Download current lists. The columns match the import templates, so you can edit and re-import.

report.fatalHint: Fix the problem below, save as CSV and upload it again.
report.readyHint: Rows with problems will be skipped. You can fix them and import a corrected file afterwards — rows already imported are updated, not duplicated.
report.start: Import {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}
report.startTitle: Import {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}?
report.startDescription: This adds or updates records in your school. Each change is recorded in the audit log.
report.cancelDescription: Rows already imported stay; the rest won't be imported.
report.failedHint: Rows imported before it stopped were saved. Upload the file again to finish — existing rows will be updated, not duplicated.

errors.noFile: Choose a CSV file to upload

onboarding.title: Set up your school
onboarding.description: A few steps to get EduCore ready for your teachers, students and parents. Each step ticks itself off as you go.
onboarding.completeDescription: Every setup step is done. You can hide this checklist now.
onboarding.completeNext: Next: teachers can sign in and see their classes. You can invite parents from the Parents page whenever you're ready.

academicYear.title: Create your academic year
academicYear.todo: Everything in EduCore — classes, students, attendance — belongs to a school year. Start by creating the current one.

classes.title: Add classes and sections
classes.todo: Add each class (e.g. JSS 1) and its sections (A, B …) for this year. You can type them in or import a file.
classes.done: {classes, plural, one {# class} other {# classes}}, {sections, plural, one {# section} other {# sections}}.

staff.title: Add your teachers and staff
staff.todo: Import your staff list from a spreadsheet, or add teachers one by one.

students.title: Add your students
students.todo: Import your student list (with a parent or guardian per student), or add students one by one.

settings.title: School settings
settings.description: Terms, grading and how results are worked out for your school.

terms.noYearDescription: Terms belong to an academic year.
terms.emptyDescription: Add the three usual terms with suggested dates and adjust them, or add your own.
terms.suggestedAdded: Added three terms to {year}. Check the dates match your calendar.
terms.name: Name
terms.inactiveYearNote: This isn't the active year, so none of its terms can be the current term.
terms.setCurrentDescription: Attendance, scores and results will default to {name} for everyone in the school.
terms.deleteDescription: The term is removed from this academic year.
terms.withinYear: Dates must fall within {year}, and terms can't overlap.

errors.endBeforeStart: The term must end after it starts.
errors.outsideYear: The term must fall within the academic year.
errors.tooMany: An academic year can have at most 12 terms.
errors.yearNotActive: Make this academic year active first — only a term in the active year can be current.

grading.intro: A subject total of at least the minimum score earns that grade, up to the next band. Totals are rounded to one decimal place first, so 69.95 counts as 70.
grading.startingPoint: This is a common scale to start from — change it to match your school, then save.
grading.previewUnavailable: Fill in every row to see the ranges.

errors.noZeroBand: One band must start at 0, so every score gets a grade.
errors.duplicateMin: Two bands start at the same score.

scores.intro: What a subject's term score is made of. The components must add up to 100 — for example CA1 20 + CA2 20 + Exam 60.
scores.startingPoint: These are common components to start from — change them to match your school, then save.
scores.name: Component
scores.lockedHint: Scores have been recorded for this component, so it can't be removed. You can still rename it or change its marks.

errors.sumNot100: The components add up to {sum}; they must add up to 100.
errors.badWeight: Use a number of marks above 0, up to 100.
errors.inUse: {name} already has scores recorded, so it can't be removed.

options.intro: School-wide choices for results and attendance.
options.showPositionHint: Adds each student's position (e.g. 3rd of 32) to results and report cards. Off by default.
options.editDays: Teachers can change a register for (days)
options.editDaysHint: After this, only admins can change it. 0 = same day only.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.description: Take each class's daily register and see who's been away.
attendance.noYearDescription: Registers belong to the active academic year.
attendance.adminWindow: As an admin you can correct any earlier day this year.
attendance.teacherWindow: You can change a register for up to {days, plural, =0 {the same day} one {# day} other {# days}}.
attendance.weekend: This is a weekend. Registers aren't expected, but you can still take one.

locked.future: You can't take a register for a future date.
locked.tooOld: This day is past the edit window, so the register is read-only. Ask an admin if it needs correcting.
locked.outsideYear: This day is outside the active academic year, so the register is read-only.

attendance.noSectionsAdminHint: Add classes and sections under Academics first.
attendance.noSectionsTeacherHint: You'll see a section here once you're its form teacher or teach a subject in it.
attendance.noStudentsHint: Students appear here once they're enrolled in this section.
attendance.saved: Register saved ({count, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}}).
attendance.rateExplained: Attendance rate = days present or late ÷ days marked, leaving out excused absences.
attendance.profileEmpty: No registers taken yet this term.

errors.yearNotActive: This section belongs to an academic year that isn't active.
errors.future: You can't take a register for a future date.
errors.tooOld: This day is past the edit window. Ask an admin to correct it.
errors.outsideYear: This day is outside the academic year.
errors.duplicateStudent: A student appears twice in this register.

gradebook.title: Scores & results
gradebook.description: Enter each subject's scores for the term, then publish results to families.
gradebook.noYearDescription: Scores belong to the active academic year.
gradebook.noTermsAdmin: Add the year's terms in School settings first — scores are recorded per term.
gradebook.noTermsTeacher: Your school hasn't set up terms yet. Ask an admin.
gradebook.noComponents: No score components are set up yet, so there's nothing to enter.
gradebook.noPairsAdminHint: Assign teachers to subjects under Academics → Teacher assignments; each assignment gets a gradebook.
gradebook.noPairsTeacherHint: You'll see a gradebook for each subject you're assigned to teach.
gradebook.lockedPublishedAdmin: Results for this class were published {when}, so scores are locked. Unpublish them under Class results to make changes.
gradebook.lockedPublishedTeacher: Results for this class were published {when}, so scores are locked. Ask an admin if something needs correcting.

locked.yearNotActive: This academic year isn't active, so its scores are read-only.
locked.noComponents: No score components are set up yet. An admin can add them in School settings.

gradebook.saved: Scores saved ({count, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}}).
gradebook.hint: Type a score and press Enter to move down. Leave a cell empty for "not scored yet".
gradebook.caption: Scores for each student and component, with total and grade
gradebook.subject: Subject
gradebook.unsaved: {count, plural, one {# unsaved change} other {# unsaved changes}}

errors.yearNotActive: This academic year isn't active, so its scores can't be changed.
errors.published: Results for this class and term are published, so scores are locked. An admin must unpublish them first.
errors.outOfRange: A {component} score must be between 0 and {max}, with at most 2 decimal places.

import.filled: {count, plural, one {# score} other {# scores}} filled in from the file. Check them, then save.
import.issuesTitle: {count, plural, one {# problem} other {# problems}} in the file — those scores were skipped:
import.tooLarge: The file is larger than 2 MB.

issues.noAdmissionColumn: The file needs an admission_no column.
issues.noComponentColumns: No columns match your score components (use the same names, e.g. from an export of this gradebook).

gradebook.publishedBy: Published by {name}, {when}. Parents and students can see these results; scores are locked.
gradebook.missingScores: {count, plural, one {# score is} other {# scores are}} still missing. Families only see results once you publish.
gradebook.allScoresIn: All scores are in. Families only see results once you publish.
gradebook.positionValue: {position, selectordinal, one {#st} two {#nd} few {#rd} other {#th}} of {total}

publish.publishDescription: Parents and students will see these results, and scores will be locked for teachers.
publish.publishMissing: {count, plural, one {# score is} other {# scores are}} still missing — those subjects will show as incomplete.
publish.unpublishDescription: Families will stop seeing these results, teachers can change scores again, and the class's report cards for this term will need regenerating.

gradebook.notYetPublished: Results will appear here once the school publishes them.
gradebook.incompleteNote: * Some components aren't scored yet; the subject has no grade and isn't in the average.

reportCards.title: Report cards
reportCards.description: Write comments, generate each class's report cards for the term, and print or share them.
reportCards.noYearDescription: Report cards belong to the active academic year.
reportCards.noTermsHint: Report cards are per term. An admin adds terms in School settings.
reportCards.noSectionsAdminHint: Add classes and sections under Academics first.
reportCards.noSectionsTeacherHint: Form teachers write report-card comments for their sections. You'll see a section here once you're its form teacher.
reportCards.outdatedCount: {count, plural, one {# card changed since generating} other {# cards changed since generating}}
reportCards.steps: 1. Write comments → 2. Publish the class's results (Scores & results) → 3. Generate → 4. Download or let parents download.
reportCards.needPublished: Publish this class's {term} results first (Scores & results → Class results). Report cards show published results only.
reportCards.needPublishedTeacher: You can write comments now. Cards are generated once an admin publishes the results.
reportCards.generateDescription: Each student's card is frozen with today's results, attendance and comments. Parents can download them straight away. Regenerating later replaces the cards.
reportCards.runFailed: The last generation failed. Try again; if it keeps failing, contact support.
reportCards.teacherPlaceholder: e.g. Amaka works hard and participates well in class.
reportCards.principalPlaceholder: e.g. A good term. Keep it up.
reportCards.saved: Comments saved ({count, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}}).
reportCards.applyAll: Apply to all blank principal's comments
reportCards.applyAllPlaceholder: Type a comment to fill every blank principal's comment
reportCards.familyNotReady: The report card for this term isn't ready yet.

errors.notPublished: Publish this class's results for the term before generating report cards.
errors.alreadyRunning: Report cards for this section are already being generated.
errors.notFormTeacher: Only the section's form teacher (or an admin) can write these comments.
errors.principalOnly: Only school admins can write the principal's comment.
errors.tooLong: Comments can be at most 600 characters.
errors.queueFailed: Couldn't start generating. Try again in a minute.
errors.noStudents: There are no students in this section.
